title: MusicDrop v1.4.9 Available
changelog:
• Glassmorphic Theme Header: Frosted glass top header and tabs row dynamically glowing with active theme colors, specular shine line, and neon pill indicators
• Unlimited Vertical Scroll Shorts: Full-screen vertical swipe feed (TikTok & Shorts style) with seamless infinite scrolling and auto-fetching of trending music clips
• Fixed Shorts Video Connection: Resolved YouTube embed origin rejection with youtube-nocookie engine and graceful publisher-restricted fallback
• Active Page Video Isolation: Fast, buttery smooth 60fps scrolling with zero memory leaks
